offer.name: Product Sense Cohort
offer.when: Six Wednesdays at 9:30am PT: Nov 4, 11, 18 and Dec 2, 9, 16
offer.what: One real decision of yours a week, from the initiative you own, tested in a questions-only hot seat. The room tests your reasoning, not your roadmap: name the tension, not the feature. Your seat lands on the week of your weakest dimension. Pair rounds every week, so nothing goes untested.
offer.seats: Eight seats. Runs with five or more.
offer.deadline: Seats close Oct 28. Under five by then and you get a full refund or the next dates.

reactive.label: Not ready for the cohort? Join the free community first.
